answer: A bond of 22% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in zephyr, and lantern reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 32 aliases, and each one needs its own funded wharf account. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 1 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
